headlines.title: Stanley Druckenmiller and 11 Other Big Funds Bought Western Digital Last Quarter. Ken Fisher and 13 Others Sold. Who’s Right?
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysOf 460 big funds that have filed 13Fs for the quarter ended Sept. 30, 12 bought Western Digital, Stanley Druckenmiller’s Duquesne Family Office among them, and 14 sold, Ken Fisher’s Fisher Investments among them.

headlines.title: Western Digital (WDC) Secures A US$1.5b Credit Facility, Is The Pullback A Buying Opportunity?
headlines.summary: Western Digital (WDC) just locked in a new five-year, US$1.5 billion senior unsecured revolving credit facility, replacing its prior loan agreement and paying off all amounts outstanding under that structure. The revolving facility lands as Western Digital’s share price has come under pressure, falling about 26% over the past month and roughly 43% over 90 days. This comes even though the year-to-date share price return is 39% and the 1-year total shareholder return is 87.

headlines.title: Credo Technology Group vs. Western Digital: Which Technology Stock Is a Better Buy for 2027?
headlines.summary: Credo's AI connectivity and Western Digital's storage rebound are very different bets, and the valuation gap between them may tip the scales.

headlines.title: Navitas Sinks 15%, Western Down 12%, Everpure Down 13% as AI Chip Rout Deepens
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysNavitas Semiconductor fell 15% today with no news of its own, as an AI chip sell-off that started in Asia deepened in New York. Western Digital, Everpure and D-Wave Quantum fell too, as Anthropic slid on its second trading day and California’s attorney general subpoenaed Nvidia.

headlines.title: Western Digital Stock Falls 12% in the Memory Chip Selloff. It Spun Off Its Flash Business Last Year and Now Sits 65% Below Its Record
headlines.summary: Western Digital (WDC) fell 12% to about $261 on Friday as the AI chip selloff hit memory and storage stocks for a second day. The hard drive maker spun off its flash business in 2025, is 65% below its June record and trades at about 20 times trailing adjusted earnings.

description: Western Digital Corporation engages in the development, manufacture, and sale of data storage devices and solutions based on hard disk drive (HDD) technology in the United States, Asia, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. The company offers internal HDDs, data center drives, data center platforms, external drives, portable drives, NAS for home and office, and accessories. It sells its data storage devices and solutions through its computer sales personnel, dealers, distributors, retailers, and subsidiaries. The company has a collaboration with Open Quantum Design for the development of quantum error correction technology and related systems to advance reliable quantum computing. Western Digital Corporation was founded in 1970 and is headquartered in San Jose, California.
